Every day, families share photos quickly. A simple image can include more than we notice: a child's face, school uniform, home address, identity document, medical paper, or license plate. For children and older adults, those details can make them easier to identify, contact, or target online.

LeakLock adds a safety pause before posting. When someone selects an image to upload, LeakLock analyzes the file for sensitive visual content and shows a clear risk result before the upload continues.

If something private is found, the user can cancel the upload, continue knowingly, or blur the risky area first. The goal is not to stop sharing; it is to help people catch accidental exposure before a photo becomes public.

For parents, caregivers, and families, LeakLock turns one rushed click into a safer decision.
